claims.text: Harold Lloyd hangs from the hands of a clock above a city street in Safety Last! (1923).
Buster Keaton, Charlie Chaplin and Stan Laurel do not star in Safety Last!
Harold Lloyd performed much of the building climb in Safety Last! himself, with safety platforms placed below him, out of shot.
In 1919 Harold Lloyd lost a thumb and forefinger when a prop bomb exploded.
